lines: His targets are up lately: 5.0 per game over his last 3 games, against 4.6 for the season, and his target share is 20% versus 17%.
Week 12 is against NE, which allows the 2nd-most PPR points per game to WRs, though LAC's implied team total is only 18.5 points.
Coach Jim Harbaugh said McConkey is back and productive, with strong chemistry with Herbert, including in the end zone and on third downs.
